properties.query:
AzureActivity
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
| where OperationNameValue in~ (
    "MICROSOFT.INSIGHTS/DIAGNOSTICSETTINGS/WRITE",
    "MICROSOFT.INSIGHTS/DIAGNOSTICSETTINGS/DELETE"
)
| where ActivityStatusValue =~ "Success"
| project
    TimeGenerated,
    Caller,
    OperationNameValue,
    ActivityStatusValue,
    ResourceId,
    CorrelationId
| order by TimeGenerated desc
properties.description: Detects successful changes to Azure diagnostic settings that may affect security monitoring visibility.
